title: extract_cert_id_identity reparses OCSP request body
description: Reparses the OCSP request body to recover key material that build_ocsp_request already had. Old: PKIX-f1j4.9
close_reason: OcspRequestBytes now carries cert_serial and issuer_key_hash, captured from the CertID before the builder consumes it; the OCSP cache wrapper reads them instead of re-decoding the body. Removed a failure path as well as duplicate work: a decode error on bytes this crate encoded itself used to abort the whole check with RevocationFetchFailed. The round-trip test was inverted rather than deleted and now decodes the body as an independent oracle to assert the carried fields agree with it. Commit 9c381db8.
